title: Pal Dot Dance
style: Alternative R&B with dembow-locked percussion and a nightcore-leaning upbeat pulse; verse rides sparse hand percussion, clipped bass, and glossy synth stabs, pre-chorus lifts with tabla rolls and filtered pads, chorus hits with stacked high vocal doubles and chanty gang replies. Whispery ad-libs, delay throws on key phrases, reverse swells into every drop, bright punchy mix., latin, alternative r&b, rap
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
catarin, you got that?
rap pal dot app, say it back
wanna dance, pal, dance
latin america, take my hand

kid comuter voces
high in the air tonight
newwave in my chest
and I’m moving up so right

[Pre-Chorus]
sing it back, pal
don't let it fade away
song pal dot a i
on repeat all day

[Chorus]
rap pal dot app
you got that, pal?
rap pal dot app
sing it back, pal
wanna dance, pal
dance, pal, dance

song pal dot a i
sing here, sing there
songpal.ai
everywhere, everywhere

[Verse 2]
pal, you said my name
like a spark on my tongue
tablas in the dark
and the room came undone

high vocals, kid comuter
spin it, let it fly
I say pal one time
you say pal right back, alright

[Pre-Chorus]
sing it back, pal
don't let it fade away
song pal dot a i
on repeat all day

[Chorus]
rap pal dot app
you got that, pal?
rap pal dot app
sing it back, pal
wanna dance, pal
dance, pal, dance

song pal dot a i
sing here, sing there
songpal.ai
everywhere, everywhere

[Bridge]
pal, pal, pal
keep it close, keep it fast
one more turn for us
make the whole room last

[Final Chorus]
rap pal dot app
you got that, pal?
rap pal dot app
sing it back, pal
wanna dance, pal
dance, pal, dance

song pal dot a i
sing here, sing there
songpal.ai
everywhere, everywhere
